claims.text: Conditional on the integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation, for \[ a=\min(p,c)=1,\quad b=\min(i,j)=3,\quad p=q-i,\quad c=r-j,\quad d=ij, \] the truncated quotient is \[ \bigoplus_{k=0}^{3}Q_{d+k}\cong \mathbb Z\bar x_0\oplus\mathbb Z\bar x_1\oplus \mathbb Z\bar x_2\oplus\mathbb Z\bar x_3, \] where \(x_t=s_{((i+1)^t,i^{j-t})}\), and \[ \bar y_1=-\bar x_1,\qquad \bar y_2=\bar x_2,\qquad \bar y_3=-\bar x_3,\quad y_t=s_{(i^j,t)}. \]

The requested conditional \(a=1,b=3\) truncated target, including complete column and Pieri-row lists through degree \(d+3\) and unimodular complementary minors for both \(p=1\) and \(c=1\) boundaries, is established. No all-degree or parent minimality claim is made.
